claims.text: Isumbras was the son of Thain Isengrim II, and inherited the title at his father's death in . He had two sons, Ferumbras II and Bandobras, who moved North to Long Cleeve.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Took of Great Smials"

claims.text: Isumbras died in , the year when the Long Winter was followed by the Days of Dearth. His son Ferumbras succeeded him to the Thainship.
